provenance.note: The real golfer: career/real/aaron's corpus (storage/corpus/real's answer over data/) and the real bag. 13 shots, all read off HD Golf's screen: 6 with the 3w, 5 with the 7i and 2 untagged, none declared a shape and none flagged. HD Golf prints carry and launch direction and neither an impact offset nor a low point, so consistency is the only topic that exists (strike location, low point and every shape are absent, the plan's decision 3 and finding 8). It is withheld for each club, 6 and 5 judged against a floor of 10, and graded for the player, which pools the 11 club-tagged shots, each judged against its own club's medians, while the 2 untagged shots reach no club-bound topic (call 9). So the first grade real data shows is the player's, and the player's blend is that one grade; neither club has a blend. Each club's list is empty, with too few shots to establish anything; the player's lists the launch-monitor weaknesses the whole corpus establishes. Recorded by Rust, not worked: no hand and no Python stands behind this case (oracle rust, the M37 plan's call 18), so its correctness rests on the hand cases under profile/hand/, and what it pins is stability, a recorded corpus through every builder and the profile report's text, which no hand case carries.
